16hapkg:204: The short-term/long-term memory layering design of AgentCore Memory deserves close attention. Short-term memory maintains contextual continuity within a diagnostic session, allowing technicians to ask follow-up questions without repeating background; long-term memory persists technicians' areas of expertise, farmers' equipment fleet information, and recurring failure patterns. This layering enables the agent to accumulate organizational knowledge—common failure modes for a particular equipment model, the repair types specific technicians excel at—thereby providing increasingly precise recommendations in subsequent interactions. This is a key leap from "starting from zero in every conversation" to "continuous accumulation of organizational memory."
